_comment: Which bots join, with which personality (see config/personalities.json), and which Minecraft server they join. The dashboard edits this file; restart the bot after editing it by hand. server.auth is "offline" for servers with online-mode=false (like the bundled one) or "microsoft" if the bot has its own Minecraft account (the sign-in code shows up in the dashboard log). version "auto" asks the server.
